Documentation/Doppio

Editor test automation

Stable Doppio Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: headless-testing.md

Doppio is tested by driving the real widget tree off-screen: plain JSON scripts, human-like input, assertions, screenshots, baselines and GIF/MP4 recordings. There is no separate Python harness.

Note. Older revisions of this page described a Python editor_test_automation.py process bridge. That harness is gone. The supported path is doppio-headless and the committed UI flows.

The three layers#

LayerLocationRuns
Flowdoppio/tests/ui-flows/*.jsonEvery cargo test through every_shipped_flow_passes and through scripts/check-rust-ui.sh.
Driverdoppio/crates/ui/src/windows/main/headless/Actions, targets, state snapshots, screenshots and recording.
CLIscripts/doppio-headless.shAny shell, CI job or agent; no window opens.

Run the flows#

bash
./scripts/doppio-headless.sh run doppio/tests/ui-flows --format text

Each flow gets its own artifact folder. A failing step prints the action, the target, the messages it produced and a hint. Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 step/assertion failure, 2 usage or invalid JSON.

Write a flow#

json
{
  "name": "Open the Scene menu and add an entity",
  "description": "Guards keyboard and menu routing for the add action.",
  "fixture": "entities",
  "size": [1280, 720],
  "steps": [
    { "action": "click", "target": "id:editor.menu.scene" },
    { "action": "expect", "state": { "/menu": "Scene" }, "exists": "text:Add Entity" },
    { "action": "click", "target": "id:editor.add_entity" },
    { "action": "expect", "count": { "prefix": "hierarchy.list.entity_row.", "at_least": 3 } },
    { "action": "screenshot", "name": "after-add", "annotate": true }
  ]
}

Guidelines:

  • Start from a fixture (entities, empty, material, texture, scene3d, nature, water, terrain).
  • Use catalogue ids (id:...), not points, unless the point is the behaviour under test.
  • Assert after each meaningful action; put a label on assertions so failures read well.
  • Keep screenshots as artifacts; use baseline only when the visuals are the point.
  • Name the bug the flow guards in description.

Inspect the UI#

bash
./scripts/doppio-headless.sh widgets --size 1440x800
./scripts/doppio-headless.sh screenshot --annotate --name workspace --out /tmp/shots

widgets lists ids, kinds and bounds. screenshot --annotate numbers every catalogued widget and appends the legend n. id — description. The same catalogue drives the UI reference.

Capture documentation images#

Committed capture flows live in captures/flows/capture-*.json. Their shell wrappers strip the numeric prefix so image names are stable:

bash
./scripts/capture-material-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-nature-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-terrain-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-texture-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-water-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-gizmo-docs.sh
./scripts/capture-editor-tour.sh   # short MP4/GIF tour

A capture flow is a normal flow plus screenshot steps with target, padding and scale. See captures/flows/capture-gizmo-docs.json for the scene3d pattern.

Record GIFs and videos#

record_start / record_stop capture the window or one widget and encode with ffmpeg:

json
{ "steps": [
  { "action": "record_start", "name": "dock", "format": "mp4", "fps": 30, "target": "id:editor.pane.viewport" },
  { "action": "drag", "from": "id:editor.pane.tab.console", "to": "point:900,300" },
  { "action": "wait", "ms": 1200, "real_time": true },
  { "action": "record_stop" }
] }

format accepts gif, mp4 and webm; width, scale, fps and keep_frames control the output. A recording left open when the script ends is finished automatically.

Regression rules#

  1. A user-visible fix or feature adds a flow under doppio/tests/ui-flows/.
  2. The flow must pass in cargo test and in scripts/check-rust-ui.sh.
  3. New widgets get a UiId and a CATALOG entry; otherwise they cannot be targeted, annotated or documented.
  4. Visual changes regenerate the affected capture flow images; do not edit PNGs by hand.
